reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces a requirements-to-delivery workflow using specification checkpoints, red/green test evidence, optional adversarial review, and a deliverable or rework gate.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供需求审查、测试证据检查、交付复核和交付门禁的工程流程插件。
summaries.en: An engineering workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness that checks requirements, test evidence, delivery reviews, and deliverable-versus-rework gates.

capabilities: Interrogates and records requirements before implementation
Monitors edit and write operations for workflow gates
Evaluates test-run evidence and optional coverage thresholds
Runs or coordinates read-only reviewer subagents
Writes specification, delivery, and gate reports to the workspace
